40011729.author: पदार्थः
40011729.content: कामरूपधृत् who could assume any form, सः that (Hanuman), विमानेषु in the tall mansions, निकामम् freely, निषण्णः sad, पुनः again, लाघवेन rapidly, समन्वितः endowed with strength, लङ्काम् Lanka, विचचार started ranging

40011729.author: Translation
40011729.content: The mighty Hanuman, who could assume any form at will, not finding Sita in the tall mansions, again started rapidly ranging in Lanka.

40011730.author: पदार्थः
40011730.content: अथ then, लक्ष्मीवान् prosperous, अर्कवर्णेन red in colour, भास्वरेण dazzling like the midday Sun, प्राकारेण by the boundary wall, अभिसम्वृतम् enclosed, राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम् the residence of the lord of demons, आससाद reached

40011730.author: Translation
40011730.content: Then he reached the residence of the lord of demons enclosed by a red colour compound wall dazzling like the midday Sun.

40011731.author: पदार्थः
40011731.content: सिंहैः by lions, महावनमिव like a thick forest, भीमैः by fearful, राक्षसैः by demons, रक्षितम् protected, भवनम् mansion, समीक्षमाणः observing, कपिकुञ्जर: elephant among vanaras, चकाशे looked bright

40011731.author: Translation
40011731.content: The elephant among vanaras (Hanuman), scanned the mansion defended by dreadful demons like a forest protected by lions.

40011732.author: पदार्थः
40011732.content: रूप्यकोपहितैः those inlaid with silver, चित्रैः by wonderful, हेमभूषितैः decorated with gold, तोरणैः archways, विचित्राभिः with colourful, कक्ष्याभिः with apartments, रुचिरैः with beauteous, द्वारैश्च with entrances, वृतम् surrounded by

40011732.author: Translation
40011732.content: He saw beautiful silver archways decorated with gold, colourful inner apartments with beauteous entrances.

40011733.author: पदार्थः
40011733.content: गजास्थितैः mounted on elephants, शूरैः by drivers, विगतश्रमैः unwearied, महामात्रैः great, असंहार्यैः irresistible, हयैः with horses, स्यन्दनयायिभिः  chariotriders, उपस्थितम् kept ready

40011733.author: Translation
40011733.content: (He saw) archways guarded by riders mounted on majestic elephants and unwearied riders of chariots drawn by horses of irresistible speed kept ready.

40011734.author: पदार्थः
40011734.content: सिंहव्याघ्रतनुत्राणैः covered with skins of lions and tigers, दान्तकाञ्चनराजतैः encrusted with images of ivory, gold and silver, घोषवद्भि: ringing, विचित्रैः by wonderful, रथैः with chariots, सदा allover, विचरितम् moving about

40011734.author: Translation
40011734.content: There were wonderful chariots covered with skins of lions and tigers, encrusted with ivory, gold and silver with ringing bells moving about.

40011735.author: पदार्थः
40011735.content: बहुरत्नसमाकीर्णम् with many precious gems, परार्थ्यासनभाजनम् with excellent seats and vessels, महारथसमावासम् having halting places for big  chariots, महारथमहास्वनम् filled with deep sounds of great charioteers.

40011735.author: Translation
40011735.content: The palace was embellished with excellent seats and vessels with many precious gems. There were spacious places to accommodate big chariorts filled with shouts of great charioteers.

40011736.author: पदार्थः
40011736.content: दृश्यैः beautiful, परमोदारैः pleasing, विविधैः of many kinds, बहुसाहस्रैः in many thousands, तैस्स्सैः by different, मृगपक्षिभिः with beasts and birds, समन्ततः all over, परिपूर्णम् filled

40011736.author: Translation
40011736.content: It was pleasing with several kinds of beautiful beasts in their thousands all over.

40011737.author: पदार्थः
40011737.content: विनीतैः by disciplined, अन्तपालैः by guards, रक्षोभिः by demons, सुरक्षितम् well guarded, मुख्याभिः important, वरस्त्रीभिः by beautiful shedemons, समन्ततः everywhere, परिपूर्णम् filled

40011737.author: Translation
40011737.content: The place was full of beautful women, carefully protected by disciplined guards as well as demons.

40011738.author: पदार्थः
40011738.content: मुदितप्रमदारत्नम् jewels of joyous women, राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम् the residence of the lord of demons, वराभरणसंह्रादैः by the jingling of ornaments and accessories, समुद्रस्वनन्निस्वनम् like the sound of the sea.

40011738.author: Translation
40011738.content: Full of the jewels of joyous women, the residence of the lord of demons reverberated with the jingling of their ornaments and accessories like the sound of the sea.

40011739.author: पदार्थः
40011739.content: राजगुणसम्पन्नम् endowed with royal traits, मुख्यैः with eminent demons, अगुरुचन्दनैः with the fragrance of agaru and sandal, सिंहैः by lions, महत् वनमिव like a huge forest, महाजनैः by great people, समाकीर्णम् full.

40011739.author: Translation
40011739.content: The place was full of eminent demons with royal traits like a dense forest infested with lions. It carried the fragrance of agaru and sandal of good quality.

40011740.author: पदार्थः
40011740.content: भेरीमृदङ्गाभिरुतम् filled with the sounds of trumpets, mridangam and conches and percussion, शङ्खघोषनिनादितम् echoed with sounds of conches, नित्यार्चितम् daily worshipped, पर्वहुतम् with sacrifices performed on new and fullmoon days, सदा ever, राक्षसैःby demons, पूजितम् worshipped

40011740.author: Translation
40011740.content: Reverberating with the sounds of trumpets, mridangam and conches, there the demons daily performed worships and sacrifices on new and fullmoon days.

40011741.author: पदार्थः
40011741.content: समुद्रमिव resembling the sea, गम्भीरम् deep, निस्स्वनम् sound, समुद्रमिव sealike, महारत्न परिच्छदम् gemstudded ornaments, महारत्न समाकीर्णम् full of precious gems, महात्मनः of the great self, महत् great, वेश्म residence, सः that(Hanuman), महाकपिः the great vanara, ददर्श saw

40011741.author: Translation
40011741.content: The place produced deep sounds like the sea. Those mighty ogres wore gemstudded ornaments. The great vanara saw the residence of the great self, Ravana rich with precious gems.

40011742.author: पदार्थः
40011742.content: वपुषा in appearance, विराजमानम् was present, गजाश्वरथसङ्कुलम् full of elephants, horses and chariots, लङ्काभरणम् इत्येव considered the very jewel of Lanka, सः that, महाकपिःgreat vanara, अमन्यत thought, हनुमान् Hanuman, तत्र there, रावणस्य Ravana's, समीपतः near by, चचार moved

40011742.author: Translation
40011742.content: Hanuman, the great monkey, saw the royal mansion looking brilliant with elephants, horses and chariots. He thought that the palace was the very ornament of Lanka. He moved unnoticed into the close quarters of Ravana.

40011743.author: पदार्थः
40011743.content: वपुषा in appearance, विराजमानम् was present, गजाश्वरथसङ्कुलम् full of elephants, horses and chariots, लङ्काभरणम् इत्येव considered the very jewel of Lanka, सः that, महाकपिःgreat vanara, अमन्यत thought, हनुमान् Hanuman, तत्र there, रावणस्य Ravana's, समीपतः near by, चचार moved

40011743.author: Translation
40011743.content: Hanuman, the great monkey, saw the royal mansion looking brilliant with elephants, horses and chariots. He thought that the palace was the very ornament of Lanka. He moved unnoticed into the close quarters of Ravana.

40011744.author: पदार्थः
40011744.content: राक्षसानाम् of the demons', गृहात् गृहम् from one house to the other, उद्यानानि च and pleasure gardens, वानर: vanara, वीक्षमाणः observing, असंत्रस्तः undaunted, प्रासादांश्च and the mansions, चचार ranged

40011744.author: Translation
40011744.content: Hanuman ranged undaunted from one mansion to another including the pleasure gardens.

40011745.author: पदार्थः
40011745.content: महावीर्यः mighty, महावेगः of great speed, प्रहस्तस्य Prahasta's, निवेशनम् house, अवप्लुत्य jumping from there, ततः then, महापार्श्वस्य Mahaparshva, अन्यत्  other, वेश्म houses, पुप्लुवे leaped

40011745.author: Translation
40011745.content: Courageous and swift, Hanuman sprang from Prahasta's house to Mahaparshva's, and so on.

40011746.author: पदार्थः
40011746.content: अथ and then, सः that, महाकपिः great vanara, मेघप्रतीकाशाम् appearing like a cloud, कुम्भकर्णनिवेशनम् the residence of Kumbhakarna, तदा then, विभीषणस्य Vibhisana's, पुप्लुवे leaped

40011746.author: Translation
40011746.content: Then the great vanara leaped from the residence of Kumbhakarna which looked like a cloud to Vibhishana's.

40011747.author: पदार्थः
40011747.content: सः that, महाकपिः great vanara, महोदरस्य Mahodara's, गृहं च home also, विरूपाक्षस्य चैव हि Virupaksha's home also, विद्युज्जिह्वस्य Vidyujjihva's, तथैव च likewise, विद्युन्मालेः Vidyunmali's, तथैव likewise, वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य Vajradanstra's, भवनम् mansion, पुप्लुवे leaped

40011747.author: Translation
40011747.content: The great vanara leaped from Mahodara's to Virupaksha's, from Vidyujjihva's to Vidyunmali and then to Vajradanstra's.

40011748.author: पदार्थः
40011748.content: महातेजाः brilliant one, हरियूथपः leader of monkeys, शुकस्य Suka's, धीमतः of the intelligent, सारणस्य Sarana's, तथा similarly, इन्द्रजितः Indrajit's , वेश्म residence, जगाम went

40011748.author: Translation
40011748.content: The brilliant leader of monkeys bounded to the house of Suka, to the clever Sarana's and to Indrajit's.

40011749.author: पदार्थः
40011749.content: हरिसत्तमः the goble vanara, जम्बुमालेः Jambumali's, सुमालेश्च and Sumaali's, जगाम reached, सः he, महाकपिः great monkey, रमशिकेतोः Rashmiketu's, तथैव च and so also, सूर्यकेतोः Suryaketu's, तथा likewise, वज्रकायस्य Vajrakaya's, भवनम् mansion, पुप्लुवे jumped over

40011749.author: Translation
40011749.content: The noble vanara jumped from Jambumali's to Sumali's and from  Rashmiketu's, Suryaketu's and to Vajrakaya's residence.

40011750.author: पदार्थः
40011750.content: हरिसत्तमः the goble vanara, जम्बुमालेः Jambumali's, सुमालेश्च and Sumaali's, जगाम reached, सः he, महाकपिः great monkey, रमशिकेतोः Rashmiketu's, तथैव च and so also, सूर्यकेतोः Suryaketu's, तथा likewise, वज्रकायस्य Vajrakaya's, भवनम् mansion, पुप्लुवे jumped over

40011750.author: Translation
40011750.content: The noble vanara jumped from Jambumali's to Sumali's and from  Rashmiketu's, Suryaketu's and to Vajrakaya's residence.

40011751.author: पदार्थः
40011751.content: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod (Hanuman), धूम्राक्षस्य Dhumraksha's, सम्पातेः Sampati's, विद्युद्रूपस्य Vidyudrupa's, भीमस्य Bhima's, घनस्य Ghana's, विघनस्य च Vighana's, शुकनासस्य Shukanasa's, वक्रस्य Vakra's, शठस्य Shatha's, विकटस्य च and Vikata's, ब्रह्मकर्णस्य Brahmakarna's, दंष्ट्रस्य Damshtra's, रोमशस्य Romasa's, रक्षसः of the demons, युद्धोन्मत्तस्य Yuddhonmatta's, मत्तस्य Matta's, ध्वजग्रीवस्य Dhvajagriva's, नादिनः Nadi's, विद्युज्जिह्वेन्द्रजिह्वानाम् of Vidyujjihva's and Indrajihva's, तथा similarly, हस्तिमुखस्य च, Hastimukha's करालस्य Karala's, पिशाचस्य Pisacha's, शोणिताक्षस्य चैव Sonitaksha's also, हि indeed,

40011751.author: Translation
40011751.content: Hanuman jumped the houses of Dhumraksha, Sampati, Vidyudrupa, Bhima, Ghana and Vighana, Sukanasa, Vakra, Shatha, Vikata, Brahmakarna, Damshtra Romasa, Yuddhonmatta, Matta, Dhvajagriva, Nadi, Vidyujjihva and Indrajihva Hastimukha, Karala, Pisacha and Sonitaksha.

40011752.author: पदार्थः
40011752.content: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod (Hanuman), धूम्राक्षस्य Dhumraksha's, सम्पातेः Sampati's, विद्युद्रूपस्य Vidyudrupa's, भीमस्य Bhima's, घनस्य Ghana's, विघनस्य च Vighana's, शुकनासस्य Shukanasa's, वक्रस्य Vakra's, शठस्य Shatha's, विकटस्य च and Vikata's, ब्रह्मकर्णस्य Brahmakarna's, दंष्ट्रस्य Damshtra's, रोमशस्य Romasa's, रक्षसः of the demons, युद्धोन्मत्तस्य Yuddhonmatta's, मत्तस्य Matta's, ध्वजग्रीवस्य Dhvajagriva's, नादिनः Nadi's, विद्युज्जिह्वेन्द्रजिह्वानाम् of Vidyujjihva's and Indrajihva's, तथा similarly, हस्तिमुखस्य च, Hastimukha's करालस्य Karala's, पिशाचस्य Pisacha's, शोणिताक्षस्य चैव Sonitaksha's also, हि indeed,

40011752.author: Translation
40011752.content: Hanuman jumped the houses of Dhumraksha, Sampati, Vidyudrupa, Bhima, Ghana and Vighana, Sukanasa, Vakra, Shatha, Vikata, Brahmakarna, Damshtra Romasa, Yuddhonmatta, Matta, Dhvajagriva, Nadi, Vidyujjihva and Indrajihva Hastimukha, Karala, Pisacha and Sonitaksha.

40011753.author: पदार्थः
40011753.content: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod (Hanuman), धूम्राक्षस्य Dhumraksha's, सम्पातेः Sampati's, विद्युद्रूपस्य Vidyudrupa's, भीमस्य Bhima's, घनस्य Ghana's, विघनस्य च Vighana's, शुकनासस्य Shukanasa's, वक्रस्य Vakra's, शठस्य Shatha's, विकटस्य च and Vikata's, ब्रह्मकर्णस्य Brahmakarna's, दंष्ट्रस्य Damshtra's, रोमशस्य Romasa's, रक्षसः of the demons, युद्धोन्मत्तस्य Yuddhonmatta's, मत्तस्य Matta's, ध्वजग्रीवस्य Dhvajagriva's, नादिनः Nadi's, विद्युज्जिह्वेन्द्रजिह्वानाम् of Vidyujjihva's and Indrajihva's, तथा similarly, हस्तिमुखस्य च, Hastimukha's करालस्य Karala's, पिशाचस्य Pisacha's, शोणिताक्षस्य चैव Sonitaksha's also, हि indeed,

40011753.author: Translation
40011753.content: Hanuman jumped the houses of Dhumraksha, Sampati, Vidyudrupa, Bhima, Ghana and Vighana, Sukanasa, Vakra, Shatha, Vikata, Brahmakarna, Damshtra Romasa, Yuddhonmatta, Matta, Dhvajagriva, Nadi, Vidyujjihva and Indrajihva Hastimukha, Karala, Pisacha and Sonitaksha.

40011754.author: पदार्थः
40011754.content: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, महायशाः illustrious, महाकपिः great monkey, सः हनुमान् Hanuman, महार्हेषु in lofty places, तेषु तेषु in several places, भवनेषु in mansions, क्रमेणैव in order, क्रममाणः while he was advancing, ऋद्धिमताम् of the wealthy ones, तेषाम् their, ऋद्धिम् wealth, ददर्श saw

40011754.author: Translation
40011754.content: The illustrious son of the Windgod jumped from house to house in an order and saw the wealth of the wealthy in the lofty mansions.

40011755.author: पदार्थः
40011755.content: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, महायशाः illustrious, महाकपिः great monkey, सः हनुमान् Hanuman, महार्हेषु in lofty places, तेषु तेषु in several places, भवनेषु in mansions, क्रमेणैव in order, क्रममाणः while he was advancing, ऋद्धिमताम् of the wealthy ones, तेषाम् their, ऋद्धिम् wealth, ददर्श saw

40011755.author: Translation
40011755.content: The illustrious son of the Windgod jumped from house to house in an order and saw the wealth of the wealthy in the lofty mansions.

40011756.author: पदार्थः
40011756.content: लक्ष्मीवान् the lucky, समन्ततः all over, सर्वेषाम् of all, भवनानि mansions, समतिक्रम्य passing, अथ then, राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम् residence of lord of demons, आससाद reached

40011756.author: Translation
40011756.content: Passing all the mansions, the lucky Hanuman reached the residence of the demon king, Ravana.

40011757.author: पदार्थः
40011757.content: हरिशार्दूलःtiger among vanaras, हरिसत्तमः noble vanara, विचरन् while moving about, रावणस्य Ravana's, उपशायिन्यः close by his bed, विकृतेक्षणाः of hideous eyes, शूलमुद्गरहस्ताश्च holding tridents and hammers, शक्तितोमरधारिणीः holding powerful javelines and iron cudgels, राक्षसीः rakshasas, ददर्श saw

40011757.author: Translation
40011757.content: The heroic and powerful vanara saw at Ravana's residence demonesses with hideous eyes guarding the bed and an army of demons holding tridents, hammers, powerful javelins and iron cudgels.

40011758.author: पदार्थः
40011758.content: तस्य his, रक्षः पते: demon king, गृहे at home, विविधान् several, गुल्मान् army troops, महाकायान् large, नानाप्रहरणोद्यतान् ready with different kinds of weapons, राक्षसांश्च demons also, ददर्श saw

40011758.author: Translation
40011758.content: At his (Ravana's) residence, Hanuman also noticed troops of huge demons ready with different kinds of weapons.

40011759.author: पदार्थः
40011759.content: सः he, तस्मिन् in his, गृहे in the house, रक्तान् red, श्वेतान् white, सितांश्चैव pure white coloured, महाजवान् of good speed, हरींश्चापि horses also, कुलीनान् wellbred ones, रूपसम्पन्नान् goodlooking, परगजारुजान् those whch were not inferior to enemy's elephants, गजान् elephants, गजशिक्षयाम् in training elephants, निष्ठितान् exceedingly welltrained, ऐरावतसमान् equal to Airavata, युधि in battle, परसैन्यानाम् of enemy forces, निहन्त्रून् destroyers, क्षरतः  shedding, मेघान् यथा clouds like, स्रवतः pouring forth rut, गिरीन् यथा like mountains, मेघस्न्तिन्तिर्घोषान् trumpeting like a group of clouds, समरे in war, परैः by enemies, दुर्धर्षान् unassailable, गजान् elephants, ददर्श saw

40011759.author: Translation
40011759.content: He saw horses of high speed in red, white and cream colours. He saw beautiful, wellbred elephants, which were not inferior to the enemy's. They were welltrained and had proved equal to Airavata (Indra's elephant) in battles. Resembling the thundering clouds, they were unassailable to the enemy in war and were trumpeting like a cluster of clouds.

40011760.author: पदार्थः
40011760.content: सः he, तस्मिन् in his, गृहे in the house, रक्तान् red, श्वेतान् white, सितांश्चैव pure white coloured, महाजवान् of good speed, हरींश्चापि horses also, कुलीनान् wellbred ones, रूपसम्पन्नान् goodlooking, परगजारुजान् those whch were not inferior to enemy's elephants, गजान् elephants, गजशिक्षयाम् in training elephants, निष्ठितान् exceedingly welltrained, ऐरावतसमान् equal to Airavata, युधि in battle, परसैन्यानाम् of enemy forces, निहन्त्रून् destroyers, क्षरतः  shedding, मेघान् यथा clouds like, स्रवतः pouring forth rut, गिरीन् यथा like mountains, मेघस्न्तिन्तिर्घोषान् trumpeting like a group of clouds, समरे in war, परैः by enemies, दुर्धर्षान् unassailable, गजान् elephants, ददर्श saw

40011760.author: Translation
40011760.content: He saw horses of high speed in red, white and cream colours. He saw beautiful, wellbred elephants, which were not inferior to the enemy's. They were welltrained and had proved equal to Airavata (Indra's elephant) in battles. Resembling the thundering clouds, they were unassailable to the enemy in war and were trumpeting like a cluster of clouds.

40011761.author: पदार्थः
40011761.content: सः he, तस्मिन् in his, गृहे in the house, रक्तान् red, श्वेतान् white, सितांश्चैव pure white coloured, महाजवान् of good speed, हरींश्चापि horses also, कुलीनान् wellbred ones, रूपसम्पन्नान् goodlooking, परगजारुजान् those whch were not inferior to enemy's elephants, गजान् elephants, गजशिक्षयाम् in training elephants, निष्ठितान् exceedingly welltrained, ऐरावतसमान् equal to Airavata, युधि in battle, परसैन्यानाम् of enemy forces, निहन्त्रून् destroyers, क्षरतः  shedding, मेघान् यथा clouds like, स्रवतः pouring forth rut, गिरीन् यथा like mountains, मेघस्न्तिन्तिर्घोषान् trumpeting like a group of clouds, समरे in war, परैः by enemies, दुर्धर्षान् unassailable, गजान् elephants, ददर्श saw

40011761.author: Translation
40011761.content: He saw horses of high speed in red, white and cream colours. He saw beautiful, wellbred elephants, which were not inferior to the enemy's. They were welltrained and had proved equal to Airavata (Indra's elephant) in battles. Resembling the thundering clouds, they were unassailable to the enemy in war and were trumpeting like a cluster of clouds.

40011762.author: पदार्थः
40011762.content: तत्र there, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य demon king's, रावणस्य Ravana's, निवेशने in the residence, जाम्बूनदपरिष्कृताः bedecked with the gold, हेमजालपरिच्छन्नाः  protected by the rays emerging from, तरुणादित्यसन्निभाः like the rising Sun, सहस्रम् thousands, वाहिनीः troops, ददर्श saw

40011762.author: Translation
40011762.content: He saw in the palace of Ravana, the demon king, thousands of troops adorned with gold, fully protected with armour of gold shining like the morning Sun.

40011763.author: पदार्थः
40011763.content: तत्र there, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य demon king's, रावणस्य Ravana's, निवेशने in the residence, जाम्बूनदपरिष्कृताः bedecked with the gold, हेमजालपरिच्छन्नाः  protected by the rays emerging from, तरुणादित्यसन्निभाः like the rising Sun, सहस्रम् thousands, वाहिनीः troops, ददर्श saw

40011763.author: Translation
40011763.content: He saw in the palace of Ravana, the demon king, thousands of troops adorned with gold, fully protected with armour of gold shining like the morning Sun.

40011764.author: पदार्थः
40011764.content: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, सः कपिः that monkey (Hanuman), राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the lord of demons, रावणस्य Ravana's, निवेशने in the dwelling, विविधाकाराः of several foms, शिबिकाः palanquins, चित्राणि colourful, लतागृहाणि bowers, चित्रशालागृहाणि homes with picture galleries, अन्यानि and other, क्रीडागृहाणि sporting homes, दारुपर्वतकानपि hillocks made of wood, कामस्य for lovemaking (romance), गृहकम् home, रम्यम् delighting, दिवागृहकमेव च for daytime activities, ददर्श saw

40011764.author: Translation
40011764.content: The son of the Windgod saw at the palace of Ravana, the lord of demons, colourful palanquins of several kinds, bowers, picture galleries, spots for sporting, hillocks (artificial) made of wood, apartments for romance, for pleasures and day time activities.

40011765.author: पदार्थः
40011765.content: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, सः कपिः that monkey (Hanuman), राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the lord of demons, रावणस्य Ravana's, निवेशने in the dwelling, विविधाकाराः of several foms, शिबिकाः palanquins, चित्राणि colourful, लतागृहाणि bowers, चित्रशालागृहाणि homes with picture galleries, अन्यानि and other, क्रीडागृहाणि sporting homes, दारुपर्वतकानपि hillocks made of wood, कामस्य for lovemaking (romance), गृहकम् home, रम्यम् delighting, दिवागृहकमेव च for daytime activities, ददर्श saw

40011765.author: Translation
40011765.content: The son of the Windgod saw at the palace of Ravana, the lord of demons, colourful palanquins of several kinds, bowers, picture galleries, spots for sporting, hillocks (artificial) made of wood, apartments for romance, for pleasures and day time activities.

40011766.author: पदार्थः
40011766.content: सः he, मन्दरगिरिप्रख्यम् comaparable to mount Mandara, मयूरस्थानसङ्कुलम् places crowded with peacocks, ध्वजयष्टिभिः with flag staffs fixed, आकीर्णम् filled with, धीरनिष्ठितकर्मान्तम् built by skilled craftsmen with great care, भूतपतेः of Siva, the lord of all creatures, गृहमिव like home, भवनोत्तमम् magnificent mansion, समन्ततः every where, अनेकरत्नसङ्कीर्णम् full of gems, निधिजालम् treasure troves, ददर्श saw

40011766.author: Translation
40011766.content: Comparable to mount Mandara, it was crowded with peacocks, set with flag staffs fixed all over, magnificent mansions built by skilled craftsmen with great efforts, decked with gems of several kinds, rich with treasures comparable to Kailasa, the home of Siva, the Lord of all beings.

40011767.author: पदार्थः
40011767.content: सः he, मन्दरगिरिप्रख्यम् comaparable to mount Mandara, मयूरस्थानसङ्कुलम् places crowded with peacocks, ध्वजयष्टिभिः with flag staffs fixed, आकीर्णम् filled with, धीरनिष्ठितकर्मान्तम् built by skilled craftsmen with great care, भूतपतेः of Siva, the lord of all creatures, गृहमिव like home, भवनोत्तमम् magnificent mansion, समन्ततः every where, अनेकरत्नसङ्कीर्णम् full of gems, निधिजालम् treasure troves, ददर्श saw

40011767.author: Translation
40011767.content: Comparable to mount Mandara, it was crowded with peacocks, set with flag staffs fixed all over, magnificent mansions built by skilled craftsmen with great efforts, decked with gems of several kinds, rich with treasures comparable to Kailasa, the home of Siva, the Lord of all beings.

40011768.author: पदार्थः
40011768.content: तत् that, वेश्म place, रत्नानाम् of the gems, अर्चिर्भिश्चापि by the wonderful hues of gems, रावणस्य Ravana's, तेजसा च and with brightness, अथ there, रश्मिभिः with rays, रश्मिमानिव like the brightness of Sunrays, विरराज shone

40011768.author: Translation
40011768.content: The palace of Ravana looked splendid with gems of different hues and with Ravana's presence, it was shining like the radiant Sungod.

40011769.author: पदार्थः
40011769.content: हरियूथपः vanara leader, जाम्बूनदमयान्येव made of Jambunada gold, शयनानि beds, आसनानि च seats, मुख्यानि chief, भाजनानि vessels, ददर्श saw

40011769.author: Translation
40011769.content: The leader of the vanaras saw there beds, seats and main vessels made of gold.

40011770.author: पदार्थः
40011770.content: ध्वासवकृतक्लेदम् drenched with liqour and other drinks, मणिभाजनसङ्कुलम् with gemencrusted vessels scattered all over, मनोरमम् very delightful, असम्बाधम् spacious, कुबेरभवनं यथा like the mansion of Kubera, नूपुराणाम् of anklets, घोषेण by the sound, काञ्चीनाम् of girdles, निनदेन with the sounds, घोषवद्भि:  filled with sounds of, मृदङ्गतल घोषैश्च with the sounds of drums, विनादितम् resonating, प्रासादसङ्घातयुतम् with rows of mansions, स्त्रीरत्नशतसङ्कुलम् filled with hundreds of exquisite women, सुव्यूढकक्ष्यम् with welllaid apartments, महागृहम् lofty palace, हनुमान् Hanuman, प्रविवेश entered

40011770.author: Translation
40011770.content: Hanuman entered the delightful, lofty palace comparable to Kubera's mansion. It was filled with vessels encrusted with gems scattered all over. The floor was drenched with liquor. It was resonating with sounds of golden anklets of women and of drums. The rows of mansions, lofty palaces with welllaid apartments were full of hundreds of exquisite women. इत्यार्षे वाल्मीकीये श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षष्ठस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
